name: plotune
description: Plotune through one connection (mcp.plotune.net): requirements (RMS), event history (Stream) and cloud Nexus sessions, with orientation skills and the Plotune requirements-engineering skills.

interface.shortDescription: Requirements, event history and Nexus sessions
interface.longDescription: Connects to Plotune at mcp.plotune.net with one sign-in. Work with your requirements (RMS), query Stream event history safely and run cloud Nexus sessions on test hardware. The skills explain how to pick the project, keep queries bounded and confirm before anything changes data or actuates hardware.
defaultPrompt: Which Plotune projects can I reach, and which products (RMS, Stream, Nexus) does each one have?
Show the latest Stream events of my project from the last 24 hours, bounded to 100 results.
List my Nexus Edges and start a cloud session on one, then stop it when we are done.
